title: Add pagination to substitutes list
description: Backend: LIMIT/OFFSET on GET /api/substitutes. Frontend: page controls with Hebrew labels.

title: Search & filter substitutes by name / status
description: Add ?search=&status= query params to GET /api/substitutes. Frontend search input with debounce.

title: Unread notification badge in nav
description: GET /api/notifications/unread-count. Show red badge on bell icon in AppLayout. Auto-poll every 30s.

title: Dashboard charts with Recharts
description: Add BarChart for absences-per-week and PieChart for assignment coverage to the authority manager dashboard.

title: Export substitutes list to CSV
description: Button on substitutes page: download CSV with name, phone, status, assignments count. Client-side generation.

title: Mark substitute as unavailable for date range
description: New table: substitute_unavailability (substitute_id, from_date, to_date, reason). API + frontend calendar UI.

title: Assignment history page per substitute
description: GET /api/substitutes/:id/assignments — list all past/current assignments. New page with RTL table.

title: Kindergarten detail page
description: Page showing kindergarten info, its manager, absence history, and assigned substitutes.

title: Add global error boundary to React app
description: Wrap <App> in an ErrorBoundary that shows a Hebrew fallback UI instead of a blank screen.

title: Authority isolation security audit
description: Review all GET endpoints — verify every query filters by authority_id from JWT. Fix any gaps.
